changes.title: Analysis-readiness definition or known-issue disposition change
changes.description: Illustrative change to the analysis data cutoff, blinded aggregate review requirements, expected known-issue counts/dispositions, readiness prerequisites or portfolio-only closure rule.
changes.rationale: Tests whether a study-statistician readiness change forces review of the controlled v0.20 specification, blinded readiness evidence, final issue-disposition/readiness evidence and review documentation without changing statistical estimands, models or TLF content.
